name: singlet_doublets_cross_species_multiplet_detection
title: Cross-species multiplet detection
description: Flags barcodes whose UMIs come from two species in a barnyard or xenograft mixture, and estimates the total multiplet rate from the cross-species count. Reads layers/counts and the species label of each feature; writes per-barcode species counts, the flag and the rate with its interval. The default is the two-component mixture; use cellranger_multigenome only as the published comparator. Do not use for same-species doublets or single-species data.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

species_key.description: Feature column giving the genome of each feature; must hold exactly two labels.

method.description: Caller. cellranger_multigenome applies fixed per-species percentile thresholds and is the published comparator.

sensitivity_s.description: Detectable fraction of cross-species multiplets; 1 gives the uncorrected total. Supplied by the user.

bootstraps.description: Barcode resamples for the rate interval, used by both methods.

multiplet_percentile.description: Quantile of dominant-species counts that sets each per-species threshold.

default_threshold_umi.description: Threshold used when no barcode is dominated by one species.

pure_fallback_min_umi.description: Lower threshold below this value, with fold change above pure_fallback_fold, triggers pooled thresholds.

pure_fallback_fold.description: Fold-change trigger for the pooled-threshold fallback.

max_iter.description: Iteration cap for the EM fit.

tol.description: Log-likelihood change that stops the EM fit.

seed.description: Seed for barcode resampling in the rate interval; the EM fit itself is deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/cross_species_multiplet. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: n_called, n_cross_species, rate_per_called with rate_ci, and the threshold or posterior cut. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
